Name: Scale
Description: Controls the overall size of the volcano feature in the terrain. Increasing the scale makes the volcano larger relative to the surrounding landscape.

Name: Height
Description: Sets the maximum elevation of the volcano. Higher values produce taller volcanic structures.

Name: Mouth
Description: Defines the diameter of the volcano's crater opening. Adjusting this parameter changes how wide or narrow the mouth appears.

Name: Bulk
Description: Determines the mass and thickness of the volcano's body. Higher bulk values result in a more massive and robust volcano shape.

Name: Surface
Description: Specifies the surface characteristics of the volcano, allowing selection between different terrain styles for the outer slopes.

Flubs.Name: Smooth
Flubs.Description: Applies a smooth surface to the volcano, minimizing roughness and erosion effects for a clean, uniform appearance.

Flubs.Name: Eroded
Flubs.Description: Applies erosion effects to the volcano's surface, simulating weathered and worn terrain with more natural detail.

Name: X
Description: Sets the horizontal position of the volcano on the terrain grid. Adjust to move the volcano left or right.

Name: Y
Description: Sets the vertical position of the volcano on the terrain grid. Adjust to move the volcano up or down.

Name: Seed
Description: Defines the randomization seed for procedural generation. Changing the seed produces different volcano shapes and features.
